A forced failover, measured from the client

week-14 — 32.16 seconds of application downtime inside a 6-minute operation
$ bash week-14-postgres-no-passwords/scripts/failover.sh

Week 14 failover — 2026-11-22T19:14:29Z
  mode     SameZone   primary zone 1, standby zone 1

== starting the writer on the client
  215 successful writes before the failover

# Read the two timestamps together. The CLI call did not return for SIX
# MINUTES, because it waits for the whole workflow -- promote the standby,
# update DNS, then build a new standby. The application was writing again
# after 32 seconds and never saw the rest of it.
#
# This is why Microsoft's guidance says to measure from the client. An
# earlier failover the same afternoon measured 27.57s by the same method.
